verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras kiau aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Quaffing the elixir of love giving fruits of delight, how could a gurmukh explain that ineffable joy?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa oh saau na jaanai|

en.bdb: Much is said and listened to but the people remain ignorant of its real taste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaa bisan mahes mil kath vedh puraanai|

en.bdb: In the Vedas and Puranas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa have told enough about the delight of love.
One can see the four scriptures of semitic religion in this context.
Sesanag also remembers it and all musical measures also are busy in adorning it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਏ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: anahadh naadh asa(n)kh sun hoe hairaanai|

en.bdb: One becomes full of wonder after listening to the myriads of unstruck melodies,

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਪੀਲਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa kar net net peelaae bhaanai ||4||

en.bdb: But the tale of that elixir, love, is ineffable which one fortunately drinks in the will of the Lord.
